before.initiative: Understand how arrival timing affects vehicle queues under the fixed signal sequence.

proposed_after.initiative: Identify which arrival patterns just before and after the end of north-south green leave vehicles waiting, and under what conditions.
proposed_after.reason: Moving one arrival relative to green changed the eight-slot queue while the number of arrivals stayed the same.
proposed_after.next_increment: Ask operations for north- and south-arm arrivals and signal phase history; establish the available timestamp precision or count-bin width around the end of north-south green and whether it can answer the question.
proposed_after.status: proposed after engineer check; team review pending
